standard.title: Investigating Safely and Observing
standard.description: engage in investigations safely and make observations using their senses
standard.prior_knowledge: No formal prior science learning assumed.
standard.progression_endpoint: Students engage in investigations following basic safety rules, make observations using appropriate senses and simple tools, and record observations in basic formats.

nodes.label: Investigations are conducted safely using the senses
nodes.progression_checkpoint: Students can follow basic safety rules for investigations, make observations using at least three senses, and explain why we do not use taste to make science observations.
nodes.minimum_width: Students follow at least two safety rules during an investigation and make observations using at least three senses.
nodes.typical_width: Students discuss and follow safety rules (sun safe, no running, no tasting, following teacher instructions); explain safety considerations for touch, smell, sight and hearing; use tools (binoculars, magnifying glasses, digital cameras) to enhance observations; and record observations using numbers, dots, drawings, voice recordings or photos.
wider: Explore safety considerations for each sense — why we do not use taste in science investigations
Use magnifying glasses and digital cameras to observe plant and animal features in greater detail
Record observations using multiple formats: numbers, dots, drawings, voice recordings, digital photography
success_criteria: Follows at least two named safety rules during an investigation
Makes observations using at least three senses and explains why taste is not used in science
